main.description: Leaves a conversation (direct or group). For group, this effectively removes membership. For direct, membership is never removed, only changed to remove from enumerations by the user who left.

errors.description: The user has already left the conversation and is not back in (a direct conversation can be restarted by a new message, which allows leaving again).
errors.name: AlreadyLeftConvo

errors.description: The owner of a group conversation cannot leave before locking the group.
errors.name: OwnerCannotLeave
